title: The Mongol Empire
text: The Mongol Empire, founded by Genghis Khan in 1206, was the largest contiguous land empire in history, at its peak covering approximately 24 million square kilometers. It stretched from Eastern Europe to the Sea of Japan, and from Siberia to Southeast Asia. The Mongols were master horsemen and tacticians, using speed and psychological warfare to conquer vast territories. Under Kublai Khan, the empire established the Yuan dynasty in China. The Pax Mongolica, a period of relative stability across the empire, facilitated trade and cultural exchange along the Silk Road. However, Mongol conquests also caused massive destruction and population decline, with estimates of 40 million deaths.
